description: Call this whenever the user asks what WordFlux can do, asks how to get started, or wants a workspace or multi-client agency health summary. Set allBrands: true to fetch a single-call cross-brand agency overview (7-day scheduled counts, client revision requests, pending approvals, Content Automation items, and expired OAuth tokens across all brands).

allBrands.description: Set true to aggregate queue runway, client CHANGES_REQUESTED feedback, pending approvals, Content Automation counts, and token health across all accessible brands in one call

name: wordflux_get_workspace_overview
